map.支持双向转换、ASCII/Unicode、自定义分隔符、批量转换。: Supports bidirectional conversion, ASCII/Unicode, custom separators, and batch conversion.
map.把文本转换为二进制位串。: Convert text into a binary bit string.
map.：按 UTF-8 取每个字节，转为 8 位二进制，可用空格分隔便于阅读。: : take each byte per UTF-8 and convert to 8-bit binary, optionally space-separated for readability.
map.：UTF-8 下常用中文占 3 字节（24 位），emoji 常占 4 字节。: : under UTF-8, common Chinese chars occupy 3 bytes (24 bits), emoji often 4 bytes.
map.：按 8 位切分还原字节，再按字符集解码为文本。: : split back into 8-bit bytes and decode to text per the character set.
map.：理解编码原理、协议分析与教学演示。: : understanding encoding principles, protocol analysis, and teaching demos.
map.输入二进制（支持空格、逗号、换行分隔）: Input binary (supports space, comma, newline separators)
map.将文本字符转换为二进制表示，每个字符对应若干位二进制数。: Convert text characters into binary, each character mapped to some bits.
map.每个字符使用 1 字节（8位），仅支持 0-127 的 ASCII 字符。: Each character uses 1 byte (8 bits), only ASCII 0–127 supported.
map.变长编码，ASCII 字符 1 字节，中文等字符 3 字节。: Variable-length encoding; ASCII 1 byte, Chinese etc. 3 bytes.
map.可选择空格、逗号、换行等分隔每个字节的二进制表示。: Choose space, comma, newline, etc. to separate each byte's binary.
map.直观展示“字符即比特”，适合教学与位级调试。: Intuitively show "characters are bits", good for teaching and bit-level debugging.
map.讲清「字符即比特」：把一段文字转成 0/1 序列，直观理解编码、字节与字符集的关: Explain "characters are bits": turn a passage into a 0/1 sequence to intuitively grasp encoding, bytes, and character sets.
map.为什么同样一个字长度不同？: Why is the same character different lengths?
map.因为字符集不同：ASCII 字符在 UTF-8 下占 1 字节（8 位），常用汉: Because the character set differs: ASCII is 1 byte (8 bits) under UTF-8, common Chinese is 3 bytes (24 bits), emoji mostly 4 bytes (32 bits); under UTF-16 most are 2 or 4 bytes. Don't be surprised by longer bit strings — first confirm which character set is used.
map.文本转二进制。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: Text to binary. An online tool built for developers, running purely in the frontend; your code never leaves the browser.
